digest.component_or_area: close STATUS event and completion verification
propositions: A reader cannot currently distinguish a close with failed signature append from a close with the gate off, because gate state is read at close time and discarded rather than durably recorded.

The completion_expectation enum (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be written to the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, so a later reader can combine it with attestation to determine the close outcome.

The expectation is computed as the second half of _completion_precheck's returned pair, consuming the tri-state GateState, with gate state resolving first so that force closes under disabled/unreadable configs record gate_off/gate_unreadable rather than force_bypassed.
The idea->closed transition must set completion_expectation to not_applicable because it bypasses _completion_precheck entirely and represents a REJECT/DROP, not a completion.

The field is added as present-only to the reduced-state schema and folded at both *->closed edges, backward-compatible with historical close events lacking the key (which reduce to state with the key absent, never guessed).
